capabilities: Create structured daily timebox notes with focus areas, time blocks, and brain dump
Carry unfinished tasks forward to the next day automatically
Sync task completion between daily notes, project notes, and a dashboard
Plan projects with Gantt charts, dependencies, and critical path scheduling
Snapshot schedules into versioned baselines and inspect variance
disambiguation: The manifest describes simple daily timeboxing, but the README also documents a full project management suite with Gantt charts, dependencies, and baselines.
extras: The README's project management feature set (CPM engine, multi-baseline management, resource workload) is far larger than what the manifest description suggests; roadmap items like Pomodoro support and analytics are not yet implemented.
motivation: The author states that most daily note systems require manual setup, so the plugin enforces structure automatically so users can focus on execution.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes leave planning structure and carrying unfinished tasks to the next day entirely to the user.
summary: Daily timeboxing plugin that creates structured daily notes with time blocks, automatic task rollover, and a project management suite with Gantt charts and CPM scheduling.
